name: Cascade bilberry
desc: Cascade bilberry (Vaccinium deliciosum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Vaccinium deliciosum is a species of bilberry known by the common names Cascade bilberry, Cascade blueberry, and blueleaf huckleberry. It is a flowering plant in the heath family Ericaceae.
